options.region: No tenant regions selected; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Org-scoped generic OIDC to Okta; explicit JIT create/update; native inbound SCIM User only; no group or SaaS bridge

conditions: Configure a generic OIDC provider with an Okta Web app, issuer, callback and client credentials; activate it for the organization and allow external login with explicit organization targeting.
The Free offer at https://zitadel.com/pricing has quotas; Cloud and upstream Okta entitlements are unverified, not a zero-cost guarantee.
This is an org-scoped upstream login proposal, not instance-wide defaults, downstream application compatibility or AuthWeave's configured authentication.

evidence.summary: The Okta guide uses ZITADEL's generic OIDC template and explicit provider activation. No tenant pairing was configured or tested.

conditions: Explicitly select automatic creation and automatic update for this org-scoped provider; creation and profile updates occur at login, not through background provisioning.
Account linking and email trust require a separate reviewed policy; login-time JIT is not SCIM deactivation or SaaS session revocation.

evidence.summary: Provider settings describe optional automatic user creation and profile updates at login. They do not establish lifecycle synchronization.

conditions: The Okta SCIM guide assumes an existing SAML integration; it does not validate this selected generic OIDC pairing. UNKNOWN is not UNAVAILABLE.
The Preview API at https://zitadel.com/docs/apis/scim2 does not verify Free-plan access, deployed Cloud version or upstream provisioning entitlement.
Service-account authorization, identity correlation and deactivation must be tested separately; inbound users in ZITADEL do not enforce consuming-SaaS permissions or sessions.

evidence.summary: The provisioning instructions target a SAML app. This is evidence of a configuration boundary, not proof of SCIM support for the untested OIDC pair.

conditions: Limited to native inbound SCIM Group provisioning: the User-only interface excludes Group resources, and no external bridge is selected.
Do not generalize to other APIs or extensions; login claims and user metadata are not synchronized SaaS group membership.

evidence.summary: The SCIM guide excludes Groups from the native User interface. The proposed absence is limited to this interface, not all ZITADEL integrations.
